field.label: Hosts
field.helpText: For Redis Standalone, please provide the host and port separate with a semi-colon. For Redis Clustered, please provide the list of the hosts with a comma to separate them. For instance: host1:port1,host2:port2

field.label: Use SSL
field.helpText: Default non-SSL port is 6379. Default SSL port is 6380.

field.label: Authentication Type
field.helpText: Provide the authentication type. Select Microsoft Entra Client Secret Credential for Azure Cache for Redis.

field.label: Password
field.helpText: For Redis, you can provide a password (Access Key for Azure Redis Caches)

field.label: Microsoft Entra OAuth 2.0 Credentials
field.helpText: Used only when Authentication Type is "Microsoft Entra Client Secret Credential" (ignored otherwise). Configure the Client Credentials grant with your Azure AD App Registration: scope https://redis.azure.com/.default and token URL https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantId}/oauth2/v2.0/token

url.helpText: Microsoft Entra token endpoint. Default targets Azure Commercial. For Azure Government, change to https://login.microsoftonline.us/{tenantId}/oauth2/v2.0/token. Replace {tenantId} with your Azure tenant ID.

field.label: Connection Timeout (seconds)
field.helpText: Maximum time to wait for connection establishment. For Azure Redis with SSL/Auth, recommended minimum is 30 seconds.

field.label: Socket Read Timeout (seconds)
field.helpText: Maximum time to wait for read operations. For Azure Redis with SSL/Auth, recommended minimum is 30 seconds.

field.label: Enable Connection Pooling
field.helpText: Select to enable connection pooling and make other fields active. Connection pooling may increase performance by using resources more efficiently. Connection pools are per JVM.

field.label: Maximum Idle Time
field.helpText: Maximum idle time in seconds for connections in the pool.

field.label: Maximum Wait Time
field.helpText: Maximum wait time in seconds for a connection from the pool.

field.label: Key Prefix
field.helpText: Prefix added to all key values. Include a colon (:) at the end.

field.label: Remove Key Prefix from Response
field.helpText: Select to remove the key prefix from the response key(s).

field.label: Throw Exception when not found
field.helpText: Throw Exception when no result if found in the Cache. You will have to Catch the Exception and query the Backend System

field.label: Key Prefix
field.helpText: Prefix added to all key values.

field.label: Set Time To Live (TTL)
field.helpText: Set the time to live (TTL) in milliseconds. Set to -1 to disable a change to TTL.

field.label: Key Prefix
field.helpText: Prefix added to all key values.
